name: tests-half-kin-openapi-atomic-typed-json-merge-patch
instr:
kin-openapi cannot yet atomically apply JSON Merge Patches to OpenAPI v2 and v3 documents while preserving the typed document graph. Implement this without breaking resolution, validation, conversion, serialization, or internalization.

Commit each patch completely or restore every reachable object, pointer identity, and reference metadata. Malformed or non-object patches, invalid typed values, and illegal reference transitions must return `MergePatchError` with the failing JSON pointer and cause. Context cancellation returns the context error with the same rollback guarantee.

Support deletion, replacement, and recursive object updates for standard fields, extensions, arbitrary example content, maps, collections, pointers, and scalars. Preserve validation, reference-sibling, serialization, and absent-versus-explicit-value rules. Reference mutations retain resolved target identity, origin, and first source path unless later resolution changes them.

Representable v2 mutations must have equivalent observable v3 content whether applied before or after conversion. Return a typed incompatibility error for unrepresentable v2-only mutations. With no patches, behavior remains unchanged.

The loader resolves the document, then applies patches in order, with each observing earlier commits.
